result.summary: Found 3 issues: a broken discount badge showing '-0%', truncated restaurant name, and placeholder-style blurry images.

issues.description: The pizza card badge shows '-0%', which is a nonsensical discount value that appears to be a data or formatting bug
issues.suggestion: Fix the discount calculation/formatting logic, or hide the badge when the discount is zero

issues.description: The third restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated in the 'Fastest near you' carousel
issues.suggestion: Allow name wrapping to two lines or adjust card width/typography so names fit

issues.description: Restaurant images appear to be low-quality illustrations/placeholders with heavy blur, reducing visual polish
issues.suggestion: Replace with real, high-resolution restaurant photos once available
